structure: Single high school course. Header gives 'Grade/Course: Political Science/ Government / ACCN: No ACCN'. Pages are series of small tables: Strand ((name not shown)) + Standard heading: 'Standard N: ...'; per benchmark a table with Topic, benchmark text and code (Benchmark / SS.PSG.n.m in separate rows), Sample Performance (example task), 'Assessment (SPA)' and a 4-level Rubric (Advanced/Proficient/Partially Proficient/Novice in C1-C4). Rubric sentences sometimes split across page breaks.
issues: Rubric rows and 'Assessment (SPA)' labels labeled backup as assessment material; 'Sample Performance' tasks labeled examples.
Course has no stated grade; assigned 9-12.
u1-u2 are untabled header lines (positioned text) labeled backup. Course title written 'Political Science/ Government' (with the space) in the header; used as the course string.

u204-u230: a second 'Standard 2: Understand the role of United States policies in international relations' heading (u205) appears after Standard 3 (SS.PSG.3.1-3.2) and introduces benchmark SS.PSG.2.3; then Standard 3 is repeated (u229) for SS.PSG.3.3-3.5; the original order is as printed. Note benchmark SS.PSG.2.3 appears after 3.2 and SS.PSG.2.4 (u132) is the next benchmark after 2.2 with no 2.3 in that position.
u60-u67, u220-u227, u281-u286: rubric sentences split across page breaks (backup).
Strand name (course name) cell is missing on the first Strand table (u3).
